metadata.title: Robinhood’s Push Beyond Meme Stocks Makes it a ‘Generational Growth Story’<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Robinhood Pushes Beyond Meme Stocks, Making It a ‘Generational Growth Story’ With 37% Upside
Robinhood Markets has struggled to gain traction among investors this year, but some analysts believe the trading platform’s expansion beyond its brokerage roots could fuel a rebound in shares.
